About Event

​The **VAST Builders Challenge** is a three-city technical event series bringing together founders and engineers across **New York, London, and San Francisco** to build production-ready AI systems.

​ **Spend the day building agents to unlock the value of video.** Becausevideo is hard to search and analyze,  most of it stays in storage, unwatched and underused.

​Experiment with the latest AI infrastructure, collaborate with other ambitious builders, and turn your ideas into shippable prototypes - with access to expert guidance, compute, and the tools you need to ship.

​Hosted with **VAST Data** in collaboration with **NVIDIA**, **SpaceXAI**, **CoreWeave** and **Weights & Biases.**

​ **_Note: Registration closes on September 30th._**

# ​Prizes
- ​1st place: NVIDIA DGX Spark™
- ​HuggingFace Microduck
- ​Cursor Credits
- ​Cash Gift Cards

# ​The Builders Stack
​Here's what you get out of the box, a lightning-quick setup:

- ​ **Video understanding:** reason over a video clip with NVIDIA Cosmos.
- ​ **Semantic search:** find moments across hours of footage using natural language.
- ​ **Object detection:** real-time detection and tracking across frames with YOLO.
- ​ **General-purpose LLMs:** models from Weights & Biases to power your application logic (e.g. video agents).

​The VAST AI OS orchestrates the video ingestion and data layer, models are served on CoreWeave GPUs, and builders ship with Cursor.

​Build your own video agent or something no one’s thought of. We'll share the videos to get you started on building video agents.

# ​Judges
​ **[Hassan Moustafa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hassan-moustafa04/?utm_source=luma)** **-** TME, Multimodal AI @ NVIDIA

​ **[Adam Ryason, Ph.D.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-ryason/?utm_source=luma)** **-** Product @ NVIDIA

​ **[Ram B.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ram-bansal/?utm_source=luma)** **-** Sr. Developer Advocate @ VAST Data

​ **[Brian Verkley](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brianverkley/?utm_source=luma)**- Director, AI Data Platform @ VAST Data

​ **[Anushrav V.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anushrav-vatsa/?utm_source=luma)** **-** Solutions Architect, Physical AI Lead @ CoreWeave

​ **[Arnav Verma](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arnavverma/?utm_source=luma)**- Field Engineer @ SpaceXAI

# ​Sponsors
​ **[VAST Data:](https://www.vastdata.com/?utm_source=luma)** A unified AI data platform that provides the foundation for managing, processing, and activating data for AI workloads

​ **[CoreWeave](https://www.coreweave.com/?utm_source=luma)** [:](https://www.coreweave.com/?utm_source=luma) AI cloud infrastructure that delivers high-performance GPU compute for training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads.

​ **[SpaceXAI](https://cursor.com/?utm_source=luma)** **:** AI-assisted software development tools that help developers move from idea to implementation faster

​ **[NVIDIA:](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/?utm_source=luma)** Accelerated computing and AI software that enables developers to build and deploy advanced AI applications

​ **[Weights & Biases (A CoreWeave company)](https://wandb.ai/login?utm_source=luma)** [:](https://wandb.ai/login?utm_source=luma) AI developer tools for experiment tracking, model evaluation, and collaborative ML development

The **VAST Builders Challenge** is a three-city technical event series bringing together founders and engineers across **New York, London, and San Francisco** to build production-ready AI systems.

​ **Spend the day building agents to unlock the value of video.** Because**** video is hard to search and analyze,  most of it stays in storage, unwatched and underused.

​Experiment with the latest AI infrastructure, collaborate with other ambitious builders, and turn your ideas into shippable prototypes - with access to expert guidance, compute, and the tools you need to ship.

​Hosted with **VAST Data** in collaboration with **NVIDIA**, **SpaceXAI**, **CoreWeave** and **Weights & Biases.**

​ _**Note: Registration closes on September 25th.**_

# ​Prizes
- ​1st place: NVIDIA DGX Spark™
- ​HuggingFace Microduck
- ​Cursor Credits
- ​Cash Gift Cards

# ​The Builders Stack
​Here's what you get out of the box, a lightning-quick setup:

- ​ **Video understanding:** reason over a video clip with NVIDIA Cosmos.
- ​ **Semantic search:** find moments across hours of footage using natural language.
- ​ **Object detection:** real-time detection and tracking across frames with YOLO.
- ​ **General-purpose LLMs:** models from Weights & Biases to power your application logic (e.g. video agents).

​Build your own video agent or something no one’s thought of. We'll share the videos to get you started on building video agents.

# Who should attend
​Developers, ML/AI engineers, agent builders, and data engineers, from startups to enterprise teams working with video or multimodal AI.

​While individuals are welcome, we encourage teams of up to four members and will prioritize team applications. You can form a team on the day of the event or arrive with one already assembled.

​ **Applications are required.** **Space is limited.** **Registration closes one week prior to the event.**

​ _**Please register using the same email address associated with your Cursor credits.**_ _The email you use to register will also be used for the Builders Challenge prerequisites._

# Open Source at VAST
[Permalink: Open Source at VAST](https://github.com/vast-data#open-source-at-vast)

Welcome! Here you will find code labs, code snippets, reference applications, open source projects, SDKs and infrastructure tools as you build on VAST.

The [VAST AI Operating System](https://www.vastdata.com/platform/ai-os) unifies storage, database, and compute to transform data into action. The software platform is built from ground up to manage and process massive amounts of unstructured data (files, objects, tables, vectors) at scale:

[![image](https://github.com/vast-data/.github/raw/main/profile/images/vast-ai.png)](https://github.com/vast-data/.github/blob/main/profile/images/vast-ai.png)

## Explore Use Cases / Labs
[Permalink: Explore Use Cases / Labs](https://github.com/vast-data#explore-use-cases--labs)

- **[Cosmos Labs](https://github.com/vast-data/cosmos-labs)**: Hands-on labs to learn VAST through storage monitoring, metadata, and pipeline scenarios
- **[DataEngine Pipelines](https://github.com/vast-data/dataengine-pipelines)**: Collection of reference pipelines that run on VAST DataEngine
- **[Code Snippets](https://github.com/vast-data/vast-code-snippets)**: Collection of useful code snippets to build on VAST

### Application Stacks
[Permalink: Application Stacks](https://github.com/vast-data#application-stacks)

- **[Video Search and Summary](https://github.com/vast-data/cosmos-labs/tree/main/dataengine-vss-blueprint)**: Build video ingestion and retrieval pipelines. Repo demonstrates how to use data pipeline and vector database for AI applications
- **[Document Research Assistant](https://github.com/vast-data/cosmos-labs/tree/main/dataengine-research-assistant-blueprint)**: Build document ingestion and retrieval. Repo demonstrates how to use data pipeline and vector database for document based AI applications

## SDKs and Tools
[Permalink: SDKs and Tools](https://github.com/vast-data#sdks-and-tools)

## Additional Resources
- [User Community](https://community.vastdata.com/)
- [Knowledge Base](https://kb.vastdata.com/)
- [VAST for Developers](https://www.vastdata.com/developers)
- [Recent Blog Posts](https://www.vastdata.com/blog?sort=newFirst&category=product,solutions)
